Install brave-origin on Omarchy

The minimalist browser from the makers of Brave (binary release).

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add brave-origin-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1:1.98.60-1:
    pacman -Qi brave-origin-bin

Open and use brave-origin

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql brave-origin-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install brave-origin on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add brave-origin-bin. The download is 185.8 MB and it takes 458.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is brave-origin free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MPL2.

How do I uninstall brave-origin?

Run omarchy pkg drop brave-origin-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does brave-origin depend on?

The package declares 5 dependencies: alsa-lib, gtk3, libxss, nss, ttf-font. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is brave-origin in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as brave-origin-bin (version 1:1.98.60-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://brave.com/origin/download.
